correctness.rationale: The result is for equilibrium-initialized OU dynamics with an independent rate-r Poisson clock and uniformly sampled full historical position at each jump; it does not claim a stationary path law. Conditional reset mean A_t/t gives w′=2c and c′=D/μ−(μ+r)c+(r/t)w, so w′′+(μ+r)w′−2rw/t=2D/μ. The large-s Laplace condition w(0)=w′(0)=0 selects a unique transform; Kummer inversion yields the exact finite-time formula and the r=μ exponential-integral limit. The two noncritical exponents and critical logarithm follow from large-argument Kummer asymptotics. Independent numerical finite-difference checks verified the differential identity for six parameter triples and three positive times; these do not prove the asymptotic theorem.
residual_risks: No central limit theorem, almost-sure convergence, nonlinear-observable law or stationary two-time process statement. Requires uniform past lookback and Gaussian equilibrium initial law.
